inspection: Agent diagnostic inspection, not human ratings or reference approval

issues.detail: The source-root boundary gate rejects a complete sentence beginning with the discourse marker As a result.
A conditional followed by its main clause is rejected because its main root differs from the source sentence root.
A conditional plus main clause is rejected when the original comma-spliced source has a different parser root.
Comma repair can leave a sentence ending in an incomplete prepositional phrase while the parser still calls it complete.
A lower beam turns an embedded knowledge/how clause into a standalone assertion. Existing forward verbal complement checks miss noun-complement scope.

decision: Keep experiment opt-in; do not promote boundary checks or candidate search to demo defaults. Diagnostic pass rates are not independent quality evidence.
